[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
{{Ireland Native}}

'''Robert Glasgow''' was born on 1 September 1827 at Kilrea, County
Londonderry, Ireland. He was a son of [[Glasgow-3896|Daniel Glasgow]]
and [[Irwin-XXXX|Margaret Irwin]]. Robert was baptised in the First
Presbyterian congregation of Kilrea on 30 September 1827.<ref name="KilreaBaptism1827">Richard John Torrens,
[https://genealogy.torrens.org/BannValley/church/KilreaP1/Baptisms/1827.html
"Kilrea First Presbyterian Church Records: Baptisms in 1827"], entry
146, transcribed by Barbara Braswell: Robert, son of Daniel Glasgow and
Margaret Irwin of Kilrea, born 1 September and baptised 30 September
1827 (accessed 16 July 2026). The web page is a transcription of the
church register rather than an image of the original entry.</ref>

No later record has yet been identified which can be securely attributed
to this Robert Glasgow.

=== Birth and baptism ===

Robert's baptismal entry provides unusually precise information:

{| class="wikitable" style="padding:5px; width:100%;"
|+ '''Robert Glasgow's birth and baptism'''
|-
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Field
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Recorded information
|-
| Child
| Robert Glasgow
|-
| Father
| Daniel Glasgow
|-
| Mother
| Margaret Irwin
|-
| Residence
| Kilrea
|-
| Birth
| 1 September 1827
|-
| Baptism
| 30 September 1827
|-
| Congregation
| First Presbyterian congregation of Kilrea
|}<ref name="KilreaBaptism1827" />

The transcription says that Daniel and Margaret were '''of Kilrea'''.
Kilrea should therefore be used as Robert's birthplace unless examination
of the original register shows that the residence statement applied only
to his parents and that he was born elsewhere.

Because the entry provides an exact birth date, Robert's birth should not
be entered merely as “about 1827”.

=== Parents ===

The baptismal entry explicitly names both parents. The relationships to
Daniel Glasgow and Margaret Irwin may therefore be marked '''certain'''.

{| class="wikitable" style="padding:5px; width:100%;"
|+ '''Parent relationships'''
|-
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Relationship
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Person
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Status
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Evidence
|-
| Father
| [[Glasgow-XXXX|Daniel Glasgow]]
| '''Certain'''
| Named as Robert's father in the 1827 baptismal entry.<ref name="KilreaBaptism1827" />
|-
| Mother
| [[Irwin-XXXX|Margaret Irwin]]
| '''Certain'''
| Named as Robert's mother in the same entry.<ref name="KilreaBaptism1827" />
|}

The baptism establishes parenthood but does not expressly describe
Margaret as Daniel's wife. No marriage entry for Daniel and Margaret has
yet been located.

=== Family background ===

Robert's father Daniel was later documented as a watch and clock maker at
Kilrea.

Slater's 1846 directory lists:

{| class="wikitable" style="padding:5px; width:100%;"
|+ '''Watch and clock makers at Kilrea, 1846'''
|-
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Name
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Directory heading
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Place
|-
| Glasco Daniel
| Watch & Clock Makers
| Kilrea
|-
| Shaw James
| Watch & Clock Makers
| Kilrea
|}<ref name="Slater1846">Isaac Slater,
[https://www.failteromhat.com/slater/0192.pdf ''Slater's National
Commercial Directory of Ireland''] (1846), Kilrea, p. 473, "Watch &
Clock Makers", listing Daniel Glasco and James Shaw (accessed 16 July
2026).</ref>

The spelling ''Glasco'' is treated as a variant or printing error for
Glasgow because Daniel appears as Glasgow in the church, valuation,
newspaper and probate records.

Robert may have learned his father's trade, but no evidence has been
found identifying Robert as a watchmaker, clockmaker or apprentice. No
occupation should therefore be entered.

Daniel was later recorded as an occupier at Church Street, Kilrea, and
at Claragh in Griffith's Valuation.<ref name="GriffithKilrea">Fáilte
Romhat,
[https://www.failteromhat.com/griffiths/derry/kilrea.php "Griffith's
Valuation of Ireland — Kilrea, County Derry"], entries for Daniel
Glasgow at Church Street, Kilrea, and Claragh (accessed 16 July 2026).
This is a derivative index; the original valuation pages should be
examined.</ref>

These entries concern Robert's father and do not prove that Robert was
still living in the Kilrea area when the valuation was compiled.

=== Siblings ===

A contemporary death notice establishes that Daniel had at least three
sons.

Daniel's son James Glasgow died at Brooklyn, New York, on 21 January
1853. The notice described James as an artist, aged about twenty-four,
and as the '''third son''' of Daniel Glasgow of Kilrea.<ref name="JamesDeath1853">Len Swindley,
[https://www.cotyroneireland.com/surnames/glasgow.html "Glasgow
Genealogy Notes, Counties Tyrone & Londonderry, Northern Ireland
1840–69"], transcription of a notice published in the ''Londonderry
Sentinel'', 18 February 1853: James Glasgow, artist, died at Brooklyn,
New York, on 21 January 1853 and was described as the third son of
Daniel Glasgow of Kilrea (accessed 16 July 2026). The original newspaper
image has not yet been examined.</ref>

Robert was born before James and therefore accounts for one of Daniel's
two elder sons. At least one additional son must have been older than
James.

{| class="wikitable sortable" style="padding:5px; width:100%;"
|+ '''Known and inferred sons of Daniel Glasgow'''
|-
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Son
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Birth

! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Status
|-

| Before James, probably before about 1829

|-

|-
| '''James Glasgow'''
| About 1828

| Certain son of Daniel; mother not identified in the death notice<ref name="JamesDeath1853" />
|}

The birth order of Robert and the unidentified son is not yet known.
Robert may have been Daniel's eldest or second son.

=== Later life ===

No record after Robert's baptism has been securely connected to him.

The following details remain unknown:

* whether he survived childhood;
* whether he remained at Kilrea;
* whether he followed Daniel into clockmaking;
* whether he married;
* whether he had children;
* whether he emigrated;
* his death date and place.

Robert's WikiTree death fields should therefore be entered conservatively:

{| class="wikitable" style="padding:5px; width:100%;"
|+ '''Recommended death fields'''
|-
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Field
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Entry
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Reason
|-
| Death date
| After 30 September 1827
| He was alive when baptised
|-
| Death place
| Unknown
| No later identifying record has been found
|}

Entering “after 1827” is technically supportable but adds little useful
information. Leaving the death date and place blank may be preferable
until another record is found.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3896]] is assessed at 99% (proved). The held Kilrea 1827 baptism transcription expressly names Daniel Glasgow and Margaret Irwin as Robert's parents with precise dates and residence. Daniel-3896's Kilrea family and occupation context identify the father without requiring Robert's later adult identity.

Selected Glasgow-3896 fatherhood of Glasgow-3897; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare entry 146 with the original Kilrea register.

Source basis already held: [https://genealogy.torrens.org/BannValley/church/KilreaP1/Baptisms/1827.html Richard John Torrens, "Kilrea First Presbyterian Church Records: Baptisms in 1827" (), entry 146, transcribed by Barbara Braswell: Robert, son of Daniel Glasgow and Margaret Irwin of Kilrea, born 1 September and baptised 30 September 1827 (accessed 16 July 2026]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.



=== Identity caution ===

Robert had a common forename combined with a surname found in several
unrelated or unproved Irish and Scottish families.

He should not be merged with another Robert Glasgow merely because that
person:

* was born in Ireland in approximately 1827;
* lived in County Londonderry or County Antrim;
* was a watchmaker or other craftsman;
* emigrated to the United States, Canada, Scotland, England or Australia;
* had relatives named Daniel, James or Margaret.

A later record should contain at least two or more identifying features,
such as:

* an exact or closely matching birth date;
* Kilrea as birthplace or residence;
* Daniel Glasgow named as father;
* Margaret Irwin named as mother;
* clockmaking or watchmaking within the family;
* a relationship to James Glasgow, the artist who died at Brooklyn;
* a relationship to Daniel's executor or proven Kilrea associates.

=== Not the Lisnagaver Robert Glasgow ===

A separate Robert Glasgow was living with Alexander and Mary Glasgow at
Lisnagaver, County Antrim, in the surviving 1851 census. That Robert was
aged ten and was therefore born about 1840 or 1841.<ref name="LisnagaverCensus">[https://durrushistory.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/1851irishcensusreturnscommadelimitedtextfilejul24_071.pdf
"1851 Irish Census Returns: comma-delimited transcription"], Lisnagaver,
Rasharkin, County Antrim, household 35, Alexander Glasgow household,
printed p. 183 (accessed 16 July 2026).</ref>

The two men were approximately thirteen years apart in age and had
different documented parents:

{| class="wikitable" style="padding:5px; width:100%;"
|+ '''Two distinct men named Robert Glasgow'''
|-
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Detail
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Robert of Kilrea
! style="background-color:#E1F0B4;" | Robert of Lisnagaver
|-
| Birth
| 1 September 1827
| About 1840 or 1841
|-
| Place
| Kilrea, County Londonderry
| County Antrim; at Lisnagaver in 1851
|-
| Father
| Daniel Glasgow
| Alexander Glasgow
|-
| Mother
| Margaret Irwin
| Mary or Molly McCaughan
|-
| Principal evidence
| Kilrea Presbyterian baptism
| 1851 census
|}

They must not be merged.

=== David Glasgow candidate ===

David Glasgow, the prominent watchmaker and horological writer born at
Coleraine in 1824, remains a possible member of Daniel's family.

The circumstantial case is:

* David was born before Robert and James;
* Coleraine was close to Kilrea;
* David followed the same specialised trade as Daniel;
* James's description as Daniel's third son requires two older sons.

However, no source has been found naming Daniel and Margaret as David's
parents or naming David as Robert's brother.

David should not be attached as Robert's brother until a civil marriage
record, obituary, apprenticeship record, will or other contemporary
source proves the relationship.

=== Searches and negative findings ===

No secure identification was found among the currently located:

* Kilrea Presbyterian marriage extracts;
* Kilrea Griffith's Valuation entries;
* Irish probate-calendar entries;
* published County Londonderry newspaper extracts;
* online references to Irish watch and clock makers;
* obvious United States records connected with James Glasgow at
  Brooklyn.

A negative online search does not prove that Robert died young or left
no descendants. Many relevant church, estate, migration and newspaper
records are unindexed or unavailable online.
